title: DRV-095: CGUSB-ST4 used letter directions instead of numeric PHD2 encoding.
summary: Fixed in CGUSB-ST4 driver 3.0.0.10 using PHD2 N/S/E/W = 0/1/2/3 without a polarity swap. Numeric protocol is mandatory regression coverage and repaired-driver ST4 motor response is verified on NYX-101.
evidence: eba315b7041b1a19f64a1ad7864dc1a6c0019ea8:indigo_drivers/REVIEW.md:134; historical locations: `guider_cgusbst4/indigo_guider_cgusbst4.driver:110`; legacy status: Open (protocol confirmation needed); 2026-10-24 hardware experiment: task 20261024064954-2f11-verify-cgusbst4-protocol, verification.md and retained scripts/JSONL; numeric directions and padding accepted, DEC inversion relative to direct NYX controls remains qualified.

resolution.evidence: Task 20261024070358-5d13-fix-cgusbst4-protocol verification.md: 7/7 normal regressions, 2/2 ASan/UBSan transport cases, 11/11 recorded hardware cases including independent NYX motor response. Existing setup-specific DEC compass qualification is retained; no global N/S swap.
